# Èlore Florist

Èlore Florist is a flower studio at Jl. Siwalankerto Timur I No. 1B, Siwalankerto, Surabaya 60236, East Java, Indonesia.

- Phone and WhatsApp: +62 858-8560-6353
- Email: eloreflorist@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00, Saturday 09:00–16:00, closed Sunday
- Prices: starting prices from Rp. 32.000 to Rp. 240.000. A quote is confirmed on WhatsApp because flowers change with the season.
- Same-day delivery in Surabaya is often possible if you message before 12:00, Monday to Saturday.
- Pickup is at the shop. Delivery is across Surabaya.
- Fresh bouquets are prepared to last 7 or more days indoors when stems are recut, water is changed daily, and the vase stays out of direct sun and strong air-conditioning.
- The shop has arranged flowers for more than 2 years and has made about 1,000 bouquets.

Google Maps reviews on the homepage are 5 stars. The written reviews are from Kristina Angelia, Yohan Alvin Limanto, innefable Kid, matz cs, and one review dated 27 January 2026.
